purpose: Reuse the scientifically valid parts of the failed 2026-10-09 Bayesian TD spike to distinguish donor-recurrent rare biology from source/operator-shifted prevalence or measurement artifacts, without reviving the failed stage-mean formulation.

reusable_elements: prospective synthetic calibration before real fitting
null, one-source-only, sign-flip, duplicate and shared-positive adversarial scenarios
not_reused: positive pooled/latent mean as evidence of source-general recurrence
any historical posterior value from PR249
historical_reuse.lesson: A positive average effect is not the same object as recurrence. Universal/shared biology must be supported by source-specific donor recurrence and transport, not rescued by pooling.

program_definition_boundary.rule: Bayesian inference does not discover or tune the molecular direction. It operates only on a prospectively frozen candidate rare program/state produced by the target-discovery pipeline.
program_definition_boundary.historical_rare1_rare5: May be used only as a diagnostic source-shifted direction after its molecular weights are frozen; rare1 and rare5 are thresholds on the same direction and are not distinct biological programs.
program_definition_boundary.prevalence_rule: Do not use the historical global rare1/rare5 thresholds as biological prevalence anchors.

hierarchy: source -> donor -> cells; operator/technology is an observation process, not a biological identity

within_source_recurrence.question: Within each source, does the frozen program recur across multiple donors?
outputs: posterior donor prevalence/amplitude distribution per source
probability that a new donor from the same source expresses the program above the frozen biological threshold
within_source_recurrence.rule: Many cells increase measurement precision within a donor but do not create biological replication.

cross_source_direction_transport.question: Is the same frozen molecular/target direction supported across sources after accounting for measurement support, depth and detection?
outputs: posterior probability of sign/direction agreement across required sources
cross_source_direction_transport.rule: No pooled source mean can override a source that is unsupported, opposite, or not estimable.

source_shifted_prevalence.question: If the program direction recurs, does its prevalence or amplitude differ by source/operator?
source_shifted_prevalence.interpretation: A large source effect may represent different prevalence/observability while the underlying program remains biological; this is not automatically batch artifact.

new_source_transport.question: Given the observed source-specific donor distributions, how likely is the frozen program to recur in a genuinely new source?
new_source_transport.role: Secondary predictive summary; it cannot rescue failure of observed-source recurrence.

observation_model_requirements.measured_zero_vs_unmeasured: Separate states; unavailable evidence is never encoded as zero.
observation_model_requirements.support: Program-defining feature support must enter the observation model or eligibility rule so low-support operators cannot manufacture absence.
observation_model_requirements.depth_detection: Use predeclared depth/detection/support covariates or matched strata only as observation-process descriptors; do not regress source globally out of the biological state.
observation_model_requirements.operator: When multiple operators exist inside a source, estimate operator-associated observability separately from donor biological variation where identifiable.
observation_model_requirements.abstention: If source/operator support is insufficient to separate biology from observability, terminal is NOT_ESTIMABLE.

source_general_claim_rule.shared_program: Requires satisfactory within-source donor recurrence in every required estimable source plus cross-source direction agreement. A hyper-mean alone is never sufficient.
source_general_claim_rule.source_specific_biology: Allowed when donor recurrence is strong within one source but transport to other sources fails despite adequate measurement support.
source_general_claim_rule.observation_limited_biology: Allowed when direction is consistent but observability differs because of known support/detection limits.
source_general_claim_rule.operator_artifact: Supported when apparent rarity disappears under predeclared observation-process controls and lacks donor recurrence.
source_general_claim_rule.not_estimable: Used whenever required source/donor/support geometry cannot decide among these interpretations.

scenarios.ONE_SOURCE_ONLY: strong recurrence in one source, absent in others with adequate support
scenarios.SOURCE_SHIFTED_PREVALENCE: same biological program direction in all sources but strongly different prevalence/amplitude
scenarios.OBSERVATION_LIMITED: same biology, one operator has reduced feature support/detection
scenarios.DUPLICATE_ATTACK: duplicate cells/cases must not inflate donor replication
scenarios.SHARED_RARE: low-prevalence program recurrent across donors and sources
scenarios.DONOR_PRIVATE: real unusual state confined to one donor; must not be promoted to recurrent program

synthetic_calibration_before_real_fit.pass_principle: The method must distinguish shared rare biology, source-shifted biology, source-specific biology and observation artifact without turning cell count or pooled means into replication.
synthetic_calibration_before_real_fit.anti_tuning: Any failed calibration requires a new prospective method freeze; do not tune against historical rare1/rare5, corrected replay, pathology, or target-tournament outcomes.

candidate_integration.role: This Bayesian layer is a rare-program qualification/adjudication tool after a candidate survives its existing mandatory gates. It cannot rescue a failed foundation candidate.
candidate_integration.C1: Quantify whether rare shared-state structure is donor-recurrent within and across sources.
candidate_integration.C3: Quantify recurrence of query-conditioned rare programs after controlling for query abundance/depth/detection.
candidate_integration.C6: Test whether shared+query reveals recurrent rare programs beyond C1/C3 without increasing source/operator dependence.
candidate_integration.C2_C4: Only if relational replay keeps them active; quantify whether rare relational structure recurs without source/order artifacts.
candidate_integration.C5: Regulatory specialist only; Bayesian regulatory recurrence cannot rescue failure of all foundation candidates.

multimodal_extension.GSE214979: For a frozen rare RNA/target program, estimate whether same-nucleus ATAC/regulatory increment is coherent across donors and how much is RNA-recoverable.
multimodal_extension.Morabito: Use donor-level separate-nucleus RNA/ATAC recurrence; never create same-cell pairs.
multimodal_extension.SCENIC_regulatory: Treat regulon/eRegulon evidence as privileged support with uncertainty, not validated truth.
multimodal_extension.spatial: Model localization only where the program is physically measurable.
multimodal_extension.perturbation: Late directional support for frozen programs with qualified target engagement.

teacher_student_use.teacher: Teacher may retain source-qualified rare multimodal programs and teacher-private evidence.
teacher_student_use.student: Student is trained to predict the recoverable component and uncertainty, not exact teacher-private realization.
teacher_student_use.bayesian_output_role: Posterior recurrence/observability uncertainty can define confidence/abstention metadata for target qualification and later teacher-state decomposition; it is not itself the JEPA target vector.
